ohmytoken-tracker 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Tracks LLM token usage from OpenClaw gateway and reports it to ohmytoken.dev for visualization.
- Visualizes token consumption as a real-time, colorful pixel bead board with support for multiple models and time periods.
- Offers customizable board shapes, fill patterns, and achievement badges.
- Includes leaderboards, a gallery, share cards with QR codes, and embeddable SVG badges.
- Simple setup via API key; supports all major LLMs automatically.
